content: ESA - Chaotic terrain in Iani Chaos Science & Exploration Chaotic terrain in Iani Chaos 17/07/2006 6535 views 9 likes ESA / Science & Exploration / Space Science / Mars Express These images, taken by the High Resolution Stereo Camera (HRSC) on board ESA's Mars Express spacecraft, show Iani Chaos, a region east of Valles Marineris characterized by a disrupted and chaotic appearance, similar to other so-called 'chaotic terrain' on Mars. Map showing Iani Chaos in context The HRSC obtained these images during orbit 945 with a ground resolution of approximately 13.0 metres per pixel. The images show the region of Iani Chaos, lying at approximately 0.7° South and 340.6° East. Iani Chaos is one of many regions east of Valles Marineris characterized by disrupted or chaotic terrain.
